coordinate_system: x grows east/right, y grows south/down. Port position = comp loc + (dx, dy). No automatic rotation: every algorithm already handles 'facing' itself (Port offsets are taken verbatim, instance/Port.toEnd).
port_dir_semantics: dir is from the component's point of view: input = component reads the net, output = drives it, inout = both/none (pure wiring).

attribute_types.bitwidth: decimal int (BitWidth.parse also strips a leading '/')
attribute_types.int_range: decimal int, must be inside 'range' else attribute ignored (error logged)
attribute_types.hex_int: 0x.. hex (written form); parse also accepts 0b.., leading-0 octal, decimal
attribute_types.option: exact string match among 'values' else ignored

defaults_rule: XmlReader.initAttributeSet: an attribute absent from <comp> gets the FACTORY default (getDefaultAttributeValue(attr, sourceVersion)), NOT the value customised in <lib><tool> or <toolbar>. XmlWriter omits attributes equal to the factory default.

components.name: AND Gate

attributes.name: out
attributes.note: 01 = normal; 0Z = drive 1 as floating (open-drain); Z1 = drive 0 as floating

attributes.name: labelfont
attributes.note: Font.decode syntax: 'Family style size'

attributes.name: negate{i}
attributes.note: one per input, i = 0..inputs-1; true draws a bubble and moves that input 10 further out

components.offset_bounds: AbstractGate.getOffsetBounds: inputsH = inputs (+1 if even); width = size + bonus + (10 if negated-output gate) + (10 if any negate bit); height = max(10*inputsH, size). EAST: (-width, -height/2, width, height); WEST: (0, -height/2, width, height); NORTH: (-height/2, 0, height, width); SOUTH: (-height/2, -width, height, width)
components.behaviour: AND of connected inputs (Value.and: 0 dominates, else any X/E -> E). Negated inputs (negateN=true) are inverted before the function. 'out' option then maps 1->Z (0Z) or 0->Z (Z1).
notes: Ports: index 0 = output at (0,0); index i+1 = input i (AbstractGate.computePorts).

Unconnected inputs (no wire end / other component end at the input location) are IGNORED (AbstractGate.propagate: isPortConnected); if options gateUndefined=error any unconnected input makes the output E. No connected inputs -> output E.
Width attribute applies bitwise to all ports.
Input offsets are NOT a true rotation: input 0 is always at the most negative coordinate along the input edge (top for east/west, left for north/south).

components.name: Splitter

attributes.name: appear
attributes.note: missing attr -> 'left' if <project source> >= 2.6.3.202 else 'legacy' (SplitterFactory.getDefaultAttributeValue)

attributes.name: bit{i}
attributes.note: one per incoming bit i; value 'none' = bit not routed, 'k' = routed to split end k (0-based, k < fanout). Missing bitN -> end N (if N < fanout) else SplitterAttributes.computeDistribution default; see ports_splitter

components.behaviour: Pure wiring: combined end (0,0) carries 'incoming' bits; bit i of the combined end is the same net-thread as the j-th routed bit of its split end (j = rank of i among bits routed to that end, in increasing i). Bidirectional, no delay.
notes: Ports (Splitter ends): end 0 = combined at loc; split end k (k=0..fanout-1) at loc + (dx0 + k*ddx, dy0 + k*ddy).
EAST: dx0=20, ddx=0, ddy=10; dy0 = -10*fanout (left), 10 (right), -10*(fanout/2) (center/legacy).
WEST: dx0=-20, ddy=10; dy0 = 10 (left), -10*fanout (right), -10*(fanout/2) (center/legacy).
NORTH: dy0=-20, ddx=-10; dx0 = -10 (left), 10*fanout (right), 10*((fanout+1)/2 - 1) (center/legacy).
SOUTH: dy0=20, ddx=-10; dx0 = 10*fanout (left), -10 (right), 10*((fanout+1)/2 - 1) (center/legacy).
Width of split end k = number of bits i with bit_end[i] == k+1 (may be 0).

components.name: Transistor
components.behaviour: gate == (p:0 / n:1): out = in; gate the other defined value: out = X (floating); gate undefined: E (or E where in defined).
notes: ports 0=out (0,0) [source/drain output], 1=in at 40*(dx,dy), 2=gate (1 bit)
(dx,dy) = north (0,1), east (-1,0), south (0,-1), west (1,0); flip = (facing in {south,west}) == (gate==tl);
gate = flip ? (20(dx+dy), 20(-dx+dy)) : (20(dx-dy), 20(dx+dy)). EAST/tl: in (-40,0), gate (-20,-20).

components.name: Transmission Gate
components.behaviour: gate0/gate1 defined and different: gate0=0 (gate1=1) -> out = in; gate0=1 -> out floating; otherwise E.
notes: ports 0=out (0,0), 1=in 40*(dx,dy), 2=gate0, 3=gate1 (see Transistor for dx,dy,flip);
not flipped: gate0=(20(dx-dy),20(dx+dy)), gate1=(20(dx+dy),20(-dx+dy)); flipped: swapped. EAST/tl: gate0 (-20,-20), gate1 (-20,20).

components.name: Bit Extender
components.behaviour: out = in extended (or truncated) to out_width, filling with 0 / 1 / in's top bit / the 'extend' input.
notes: No facing attribute in the attribute list (fixed geometry, bounds (-40,-20,40,40)).
ports 0=out (0,0) out_width, 1=in (-40,0) in_width, 2=extend (-20,-20) only when type=input.

components.name: Multiplexer

attributes.name: enable
attributes.note: missing attr -> true if <project source> >= 2.6.3.220 else false (getDefaultAttributeValue override)

components.behaviour: out = in[select]; enable=0 -> out all Z (disabled=Z) or 0; select X -> X, E -> E. Delay 3.
notes: Port order: in0..in(2^select-1), select, [enable], out (out last, at (0,0)).
enable port = select.translate(facing, +10).

components.name: Demultiplexer

attributes.name: enable
attributes.note: missing attr -> true if <project source> >= 2.6.3.220 else false (getDefaultAttributeValue override)

components.behaviour: out[select] = in, other outputs 0 (tristate=false) or Z (tristate=true); enable=0 -> all outputs Z/0 per 'disabled'.
notes: Port order: out0..out(n-1), select, [enable], in (in last, at (0,0)).
enable = select.translate(facing, -10).

components.name: Decoder

attributes.name: enable
attributes.note: missing attr -> true if <project source> >= 2.6.3.220 else false (getDefaultAttributeValue override)

components.behaviour: out[select]=1, others 0 (or Z if tristate).
notes: Port order: out0..out(n-1), select (at (0,0)), [enable at (0,0).translate(facing,-10)].

components.name: Priority Encoder
components.behaviour: out = highest index i with in_i=1; group_signal=1 if any; enable_out=1 if enabled and none set; enable_in=0 disables (out Z/0).
notes: Port order: in0..in(n-1), out (0,0), enable_in, enable_out, group_signal (n = 2^select). No selloc attribute.

components.name: BitSelector
components.behaviour: out = bits [sel*group, sel*group+group) of in (missing high bits = 0).
notes: Port order: out (0,0), in, select. select width = smallest s>=1 with 2^s >= ceil(width/group).

components.name: Adder
components.behaviour: out = a + b + carry_in (low bits), carry_out = overflow. carry_in unconnected = 0
notes: No facing attribute: geometry fixed, location = right edge (output side); bounds (-40,-20,40,40) unless noted.
Adder.java declares carry_out (port 4) as Port.INPUT (source quirk) although propagate() drives it.

components.name: Subtractor
components.behaviour: out = a - b - borrow_in; borrow_out
notes: No facing attribute: geometry fixed, location = right edge (output side); bounds (-40,-20,40,40) unless noted.

components.name: Multiplier
components.behaviour: out = low bits of a*b + carry_in; carry_out = high bits
notes: No facing attribute: geometry fixed, location = right edge (output side); bounds (-40,-20,40,40) unless noted.

components.name: Divider
components.behaviour: quotient = (upper:lower)/divisor, remainder
notes: No facing attribute: geometry fixed, location = right edge (output side); bounds (-40,-20,40,40) unless noted.

components.name: Negator
components.behaviour: out = -in (two's complement)
notes: No facing attribute: geometry fixed, location = right edge (output side); bounds (-40,-20,40,40) unless noted.

components.name: Comparator
components.behaviour: gt/eq/lt of a vs b
notes: No facing attribute: geometry fixed, location = right edge (output side); bounds (-40,-20,40,40) unless noted.

components.name: Shifter
components.behaviour: out = data shifted by dist (logical left/right, arithmetic right, rotate left/right)
notes: No facing attribute: geometry fixed, location = right edge (output side); bounds (-40,-20,40,40) unless noted.

components.name: BitAdder
components.behaviour: out = number of 1 bits among all inputs
notes: No facing attribute: geometry fixed, location = right edge (output side); bounds (-40,-20,40,40) unless noted.

components.name: BitFinder
components.behaviour: index of lowest/highest 1/0 bit; present=1 if found
notes: No facing attribute: geometry fixed, location = right edge (output side); bounds (-40,-20,40,40) unless noted.

components.name: D Flip-Flop

attributes.name: labelfont
attributes.note: Font.decode syntax: 'Family style size'

components.behaviour: on trigger: q = d (only if d is 0/1). Default trigger rising edge.
notes: No facing. Bounds (-40,-10,40,40). Port order: data inputs, clock, q (0,0), nq (0,20), reset (-10,30), preset (-30,30), enable (-20,30).

components.behaviour: count up (load=0,count=1) / down (load=1,count=1) / load d (load=1,count=0); carry at goal.
notes: No facing; bounds (-30,-20,30,40). Order: q, d, clock, clear, load, count, carry.

components.name: Shift Register

attributes.name: labelfont
attributes.note: Font.decode syntax: 'Family style size'

components.behaviour: on edge with shift!=0: shift in; load=1 (parallel) loads d_i.
notes: No facing; location is the LEFT edge. Bounds (0,-20, parallel ? 20+10*length : 30, 40).
Order: in(0), shift(1), clock(2), clear(3), out(4), [load(5), then d_i (6+2i), q_i (7+2i)].

subcircuit.xml: <comp name="<circuit name>" loc="(x,y)"> with NO lib attribute (lib absent/empty = this file)

attributes.name: facing
attributes.note: missing -> facing of the subcircuit appearance's anchor (east for default appearance)

attributes.name: labelfont
attributes.note: Font.decode syntax: 'Family style size'

ports_algorithm.needs: pins of the referenced circuit and its <appear> (if any)

notes: Every Pin of the subcircuit becomes a port; input pin -> INPUT port, output pin -> OUTPUT port; width = pin width.
Default appearance (no <appear>): DefaultAppearance.build; pin goes to edge reverse(pin.facing); anchor (= instance loc) on first east-edge pin, else north, west, south, else box corner.
Custom appearance: <circ-port pin="x,y" x y width height> centre = port offset; <circ-anchor x y width height facing> centre = instance loc.
Instance facing != anchor facing -> offsets rotated by Location.rotate(anchorFacing, facing, 0, 0).

wires.xml: <wire from="(x0,y0)" to="(x1,y1)"/> (always axis-parallel in files written by Logisim)
connectivity: After loading, WireRepair (run by CircuitTransaction.execute for every circuit) merges collinear wires and SPLITS every wire at every point of the circuit's point map (any wire endpoint or any component port location) that lies strictly inside the wire (Wire.contains: on the segment, +-2 px perpendicular tolerance). Net effect: a wire is electrically connected to every wire endpoint and every component port lying anywhere on its closed segment (endpoints or interior).
Two wires that merely CROSS (no endpoint of either on the other) are NOT connected.
Overlapping collinear wires become one net (doOverlaps).
Component ports at the same location are connected even without any wire (CircuitWires.propagate: unwired points).
Tunnels with equal trimmed non-empty label in the same circuit are one net; splitters connect bit threads between their ends.
Zero-length wires are discarded (Circuit.mutatorAdd); duplicate wires are de-duplicated.
